_comment: #67 (M-4 exit gate), corrected by #76 -- a minimal seeded board for
`coord web --fixture`, used to drive the real `GET /api/machines` wire
shape end to end.
`coord/dashboard/fixture.py`'s FixtureServer serves this file's
top-level `machines` key back on `GET /api/machines` verbatim -- it does
NOT construct the response through the same roster-building code path a
live daemon does, so this file is this suite's own promise about what
that route returns, not independent proof of it. #76 was found by
curling a real production server and cross-checking `GET /openapi.json`
against a local `coord web --fixture` process -- see
`e2e/machines.spec.ts`'s 'real coord web --fixture process' describe
block, which validates THIS file's shape against that live OpenAPI
schema (`MachineRow`) rather than trusting the echo alone.
Field set is exactly `MachineState` (`src/api/generated.ts`, #76): no
`severity`/`reachable`/`active_assignments`/`headless_workers`/
`is_local`/`quiet_hours_paused`/`hand_paused`/`release_cordoned`/
`concurrency_limit` -- none of those ever existed on a real roster.
The per-machine nested routes the pre-#76 client used to call
(`/api/machines/{name}/...`) never existed on any coord server, real or
fixture -- `machines.spec.ts`'s 'goto /machines/:name cold' test
documents the resulting degrade against this same process.
